title: Medieval paintings with UFO-like objects in the sky

tellings.quote: you look at these medieval paintings with the thing in the sky that looks sort of like a UFO, whatever.

plain: Some medieval paintings show something in the sky that looks a bit like a UFO. The skeptic Michael Shermer mentions this on the show, waving it off with a "whatever", while naming two writers who take such old images seriously, the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée and the religion scholar Jeffrey Kripal. For those who take the paintings seriously, they would mean people were seeing such things centuries ago.
